name: Satsumasendai (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Satsumasendai city emblem in green and blue: a green stylised letter S with blue curved strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Satsumasendai, a city in Kagoshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 January 2005.

features.role: Satsumasendai city emblem — a green stylised letter S with blue curved strokes
